questions.q: Why did the doctor tell the captain to give his gun to Trelawney?
choices: Trelawney was the best shot and his own gun was useless
The captain was hurt
The captain did not know how to shoot
Trelawney asked for it
questions.evidence: Trelawney is the dead shot. Give him your gun; his own is useless.

questions.q: What did Gray's handling of the cutlass show the others?
choices: That he was a good, useful fighter
That he had never used a weapon
That he was secretly a pirate
That he was too scared to fight
questions.evidence: our new hand was worth his salt

questions.q: What happened when the seven mutineers led by Job Anderson appeared at the corner of the stockade?
choices: The loyal party fired, one pirate fell, and the rest ran into the trees
The pirates captured the stockade
The loyal party surrendered
The two sides agreed to a truce
questions.evidence: one of the enemy actually fell, and the rest, without hesitation, turned and plunged into the trees

questions.q: Who was shot by a pistol fired from the bushes?
choices: Tom Redruth
Abraham Gray
Captain Smollett
Joyce
questions.evidence: poor Tom Redruth stumbled and fell his length on the ground

questions.q: How did the squire act as Tom Redruth lay dying?
choices: He knelt, kissed Tom's hand, cried, and asked for forgiveness
He ignored Tom and kept watch
He blamed Tom for being careless
He ran outside to chase the pirates
questions.evidence: Tom," said the squire, "say you forgive me, won't you?

questions.q: What was Tom Redruth's last request?
choices: That somebody read a prayer
That he be buried at sea
That his wages go to his family
That the squire avenge him
questions.evidence: he said he thought somebody might read a prayer

questions.q: What did the captain raise over the log-house?
choices: The British colours (flag)
A white flag of surrender
The pirates' black flag
A signal lantern
questions.evidence: climbing on the roof, he had with his own hand bent and run up the colours

questions.q: Why did the captain say they were "pretty close hauled"?
choices: Their food rations were very short and help would not come for months
The pirates had surrounded them completely
They had run out of gunpowder
The stockade walls were falling down
questions.evidence: But the rations are short, very short

questions.q: Why did the captain refuse to take down the flag when the pirates aimed their cannon at it?
choices: It showed the enemy that they despised the cannon fire
He had no other place to put it
He thought the pirates could not see it
He wanted the flag to be destroyed
questions.evidence: showed our enemies that we despised their cannonade

questions.q: "Captain," said the squire, "the house is quite invisible from the ship." In this sentence, "invisible" means:
choices: Not able to be seen
Very large
Easy to attack
Far away and quiet
questions.evidence: the house is quite invisible from the ship

questions.q: What happened at the very end of the chapter, while the captain was writing in his log?
choices: Jim Hawkins called out and climbed over the stockade, safe and sound
Silver came with a flag of truce
The pirates set fire to the log-house
Ben Gunn brought them food
questions.evidence: Jim Hawkins, safe and sound, come climbing over the stockade
